description: This file defines the 'FieldFactory' class within the 'Cron' namespace, implementing a flyweight pattern to efficiently instantiate and cache classes representing different parts of a CRON expression (Minutes, Hours, Day of Month, Month, Day of Week, Year). It provides a method to retrieve a specific field object based on its position index, utilizing lazy initialization and caching.

classes.name: FieldFactory
classes.description: Implements a flyweight factory for CRON expression fields, providing cached instantiation of field objects based on position (minutes, hours, day, month, weekday, year).

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns a cached instance of the specific CRON field object for the given position, creating it if it doesn't exist, or throws an exception if the position is invalid.
